verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents an official MCP server (helix-cloud/connect/mcp) with tools like helix_execute_read_query requiring scoped permissions, and a probe confirms this MCP endpoint exists; the helix chef bootstrapper also installs a 'docs MCP'. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent successfully connecting via this MCP server, and fuller documentation of the full tool set beyond read queries.
